description:
## Goal
Address readability and reliability issues in `src/vug/fetcher.cr` (the largest source file at 234 lines). Extract unrelated internal types to dedicated files, remove dead code, tighten type safety of the fetch-loop return values, and consolidate duplicated URI-parsing logic.

## Why
`fetcher.cr` currently mixes several concerns:
- 3 private classes/enums (`LoopState`, `Action`, `RedirectLoopError`) that are only used inside Fetcher
- A dead `DDG_DEFAULT_ICON_SIZE` constant alias
- 3-tuple returns from `fetch_result_uri` / `gray_placeholder_uri` (`{Action, String?, URI?}`) that are easy to mis-order and don't carry their own meaning
- A `MAX_GRAY_ATTEMPTS` constant that lives in `LoopState` but is a gray-placeholder-domain concern
- Two inconsistent URI-parsing helpers (`Fetcher#parse_uri_safe` vs `SingleRequest#parse_uri`) with different log levels and exception policies
- A `apply_action` case statement whose control flow is hard to follow (mixes state mutation, early returns, and fall-throughs)

Splitting these out makes each unit testable in isolation, removes the dead alias, prevents tuple-swap bugs, and aligns the file with the existing refactor style (see recent commits `a6f2c95`, `dbb9ae0`, `6be767f`).

## Non-goals
- No public API changes to `Fetcher#fetch` or `Result`.
- No behavior change for any existing spec.
- No new dependencies.

## Children
This epic has 6 child tickets, each independently reviewable.
title: Refactor Fetcher.cr for SRP, DRY, and reliability
